name: File Upload
description: Most upload widgets fall over on the three things that really happen: wrong file type, file too big, transfer fails halfway. This one handles all three — per-file progress, retry, and guards that explain themselves. Part of Documents & Signing: layro.vercel.app
author: uvain
oQueDa: Upload que lida com tipo errado, arquivo grande e falha de rede.
ondeVai: Anexar peças e documentos ao processo/cliente.
compat: React 19/Next 16/Tailwind v4: revisar 'use client', trocar framer-motion por motion/react quando aparecer; cores hardcoded → tokens do globals.css.
